title: Prelude in E minor, Op. 28 No. 4

patches.basis: Replace the removed quarter-beam Scheme API with the equivalent quarter-unit grouping properties; no pitch or duration changes.

Give the complete printed right-hand expression its original named Voice; the obsolete bare Voice selector otherwise consumes a property command instead of music. The containing up Staff remains in the unchanged staff expression.
Give the complete printed left-hand expression its original named Voice inside the containing down Staff, retaining cross-staff destinations and all notes.
Rename the source's custom dim. text to avoid convert-ly mistaking its uses for the obsolete built-in diminuendo music command.

patches.old: s s s s \! #(Text 0 -.8 #t) s4-\dim s  % Takt 18
patches.new: s s s s \! #(Text 0 -.8 #t) s4-\cpDimText s  % Takt 18
patches.basis: Retain the exact printed dim. markup at bar 18 under its non-colliding name.
Give the complete original playback right-hand expression its named Voice, retaining the source-defined turn realization and all playback attacks.
Give the complete original playback left-hand expression its named Voice, without changing pitches, note onsets, or durations.
